ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 85% of the visible surface area, contrasted by low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the trailing edge and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous region across both lobes. Dark perimeter border of varying thickness (2-15 pixels) follows the trailing edge. Minimal black mottling or focal spots present on the interior white surface, with a few small dark pixel clusters on the mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-degree internal angle and a significant vertical depth relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present across the entire trailing edge boundary, appearing as jagged peaks and valleys isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex curve toward the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast dark clusters with irregular, roughly circular sub-structures located at both the left and right distal tips, indicating external growth or colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Sparse, faint dark linear pixel streaks visible on the medial-right lobe surface, oriented horizontally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral mass accumulation at both fluke tips, significantly altering the smoothness of the geometric perimeter.
